skip_reason: The SKILL.md describes `cursor` and `cursor-agent` CLI tools that require: (1) a GUI/display environment (Cursor is fundamentally a GUI editor), making it multi-modal and incompatible with a text-only Docker container; (2) authenticated network access to Cursor's backend API (Cursor Pro account/token required for AI capabilities); and (3) the documentation itself is an incomplete stub with only 3 trivial command examples and defers all substantial technical depth to an external URL (https://cursor.com/docs/cli/overview). All three of these conditions are explicitly banned per the Skill Selection & Capability Limits rules.
